description: From-scratch specialized codec. Encoder-only fitted LZ parse is validated against raw input then entropy-coded; offline fitting costs are separately recorded. Charged archive contains all literal, length, offset, and model data. Decoder: bounded blockwise AVX-512 rANS and SIMD offset/header prefix scans with prefetched LZ reconstruction. No external compression dependency.
name: python-final-fit-simd-1m
